command: find . -xdev -print 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r p; do clean="${p#./}"; if [ "$clean" = "" ]; then clean="."; fi; if [ -d "$p" ]; then kind="dir"; size="0"; else kind="file"; size=$(wc -c < "$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); fi; mtime=$(stat -c %Y "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$kind" "$size" "$mtime" "$clean"; done
